name: Statue of Liberty
description: A giant copper-clad woman holding a torch aloft, the Statue of Liberty stands on Liberty Island at the mouth of New York Harbour. France gave it to the United States in 1886 to mark a hundred years of independence. Gustave Eiffel engineered its iron framework, and for millions of arriving immigrants it was their first sight of America. Visitors can take a ferry to the island and see the original torch in the museum.
